```{r daice}

daice <- ant_ice |>
  ReadNetCDF("aice") |>
  setnames(c("latitude", "longitude"), c("lat", "lon")) |>
  _[, daice := c(diff(aice), NA), by = .(lon, lat)] |>
  _[temp_era[year(time) >= 1981], on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[year(time) < 2024] |>
  _[, t2m := t2m - 273.15] |>
  identity()
```

```{r model_monthly}
model_monthly <- lm(
  daice ~ poly(t2m, 3, raw = TRUE) * poly(aice, 3, raw = TRUE),
  data = na.omit(daice),
  subset = t2m < 1 & aice > 0 & year(time) < 2014
)

grid_monthly <- CJ(
  t2m = seq(-20, 5, length.out = 40),
  aice = seq(0, 1, length.out = 40)
) |>
  _[, daice := predict(model_monthly, newdata = .SD)]
```

```{r era_temp_fun}
era_temp_fun <- function(data) {
  t2m_matrix <- data[, .(time, lon, lat, t2m)] |>
    metR:::.tidy2matrix(lon + lat ~ time, value.var = "t2m") |>
    _$matrix
  t2m_time <- 0:(ncol(t2m_matrix) - 1)

  function(t) interpolate_cpp(t2m_matrix, t2m_time, t)
}

```

```{r poly_interactions}
Rcpp::sourceCpp(here::here("analysis/random/poly_interactions_cpp.cpp"))
```


```{r d_ice}
d_ice <- function(coefs, inflation = 1) {
  force(coefs)
  force(inflation)
  function(state, time, forcing) {
    t2m <- forcing(time)
    x <- poly_interactions_cpp(t2m, state, 3)

    d_ice <- as.vector(coefs %*% t(x)) * inflation

    d_ice <- fifelse(state >= 1 & d_ice > 0, 0, d_ice)
    d_ice <- fifelse(state <= 0 & d_ice < 0, 0, d_ice)
    d_ice
  }
}
```


```{r rk4}
rk4 <- function(model, state, time, forcing, dt) {
  k1 <- model(state = state, time = time, forcing = forcing)
  k2 <- model(
    state = state + k1 * dt / 2,
    time = time + dt / 2,
    forcing = forcing
  )
  k3 <- model(
    state = state + k2 * dt / 2,
    time = time + dt / 2,
    forcing = forcing
  )
  k4 <- model(state = state + k3 * dt, time = time + dt, forcing = forcing)

  state <- state + (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4) * dt / 6

  state
}
```

```{r evolve}
evolve_ <- function(
  start,
  model,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  dt,
  method = rk4,
  forcing
) {
  time <- seq(start_time, end_time, by = dt)
  N <- length(time)

  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = N - 1)

  grid <- start[, .(lon, lat)]
  history <- lapply(time, \(t) copy(grid)[, time := t])

  history[[1]]$aice <- start$aice
  for (n in seq_len(N - 1)) {
    history[[n + 1]]$aice <- method(
      model,
      history[[n]]$aice,
      time[n],
      forcing,
      dt
    )
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, n)
  }
  close(pb)
  history <- data.table::rbindlist(history)
}

evolve <- memoise::memoise(evolve_, cache = cachem::cache_disk("data/cache"))
```

```{r sim1}
time_translate <- daice |>
  copy() |>
  _[, t := 0:(.N - 1), by = .(lon, lat)] |>
  _[, .(t, time)] |>
  unique()


times <- seq(0, uniqueN(daice$time) - 1)
start <- daice[time == time[1]] |>
  _[mask, on = .NATURAL]
forcing_temp <- era_temp_fun(daice[start[, .(lon, lat)], on = c("lon", "lat")])
d_ice_fun <- d_ice(coef(model_monthly))

time_fun <- time_translate[, approxfun(t, time)]
# rnorm(length(coef(model_monthly)))
sim1 <- evolve(
  start = start,
  model = d_ice(coef(model_monthly), inflation = 1),
  start_time = min(times),
  end_time = max(times),
  dt = 1 / 31,
  forcing = forcing_temp
) |>
  _[time == as.integer(time)] |>
  _[, time := as.POSIXct(time_fun(time))]
```

```{r sim_obs, include=FALSE}
  sim = sim1[, .(time, lon, lat, value = aice)],
  obs = daice[, .(time, lon, lat, value = aice)],
```

## Integrating this model


$$
\frac{dC_{ij}}{dt} = f(C_{ij}, T_{ij})
$$

Where $C_{ij}$ is sea-ice concentration in gridpoint $ij$, $T_{ij}$ is the t2m temperature in gridpoint $ij$ and $f$ is the polynomial fit on monthly values. $T$ comes from ERA5.

```{r mean_aice}
    mean_aice_a := mean_aice - mean(mean_aice, na.rm = TRUE),
    by = .(variable, month(time))
```
